entities.summary: James Ray "Jimmy" Hart is an American professional wrestling manager, executive, composer, and musician. He is signed to WWE in a Legends deal. He is best known for his work in the World Wrestling Federation and World Championship Wrestling (WCW). He once used the nickname "the Mouth of the South". He was the AWA Southern Heavyweight Champion for 5 days in 1981.
